title: Bi-metal hole saw, 1-1/8 in (for 3/4 in conduit)

sources.citation: Electrician's bi-metal hole saw kits (two makers' product pages, read 2026-11-15; makers not named in content) carry 7/8, 1-1/8, 1-3/8 and 1-3/4 in saws (with 2 and 2-1/2 in) as the most used sizes for electrical work; the class cuts mild and stainless steel, wood and plastic and bores a 2x4 in one pass, so it both bores a stud and opens a steel enclosure wall. The diameter is the nominal size in inches converted exactly (x 25.4 mm, NIST SP 811). Which trade size's entry it opens follows from KNOCKOUT_HOLES and the game-design fit tolerance; no conductor size is involved.
